description: Option 20 V5b: the same 9G two-lane server after freeing host memory, no restart

server.note: same process as V5c (pid 42709); the only change is what else the Mac was running

change: quit Google Chrome (1.42 GiB with its helpers), LM Studio (0.39 GiB), Activity Monitor stayed

parent_child_server_log.parent: prefill 28,589/181.97s · PP 157.1 tok/s · decode 113/9.55s · TPS 11.8 tok/s · native_queue=0.000s
parent_child_server_log.child: Done · input 20 · output 3 · TTFT 12.6s · TPS 4.1 tok/s · frontend_queue=0.000s · native_queue=9.199s · native_wall=11.161s
parent_child_server_log.governor_line_at_child_start: Memory: growth available; resource wait cleared

cost_of_true_concurrency.row: decode-512 measured while a foreign request shared the lane (foreign_active_samples 6)
cost_of_true_concurrency.reading: two requests decoding at once each get about half the drive bandwidth the engine streams experts from, so concurrency buys latency and not throughput

harness_note: run_v5b.py now closes the child future first; the earlier harness waited on the parent's future before reading the child's wall, which inflated child_wall whenever a child finished early. V4, V5 and V5c numbers are unchanged because the engine's own native_queue agreed with them (180.264 s for V5).

verdict.lane: works: the child started 10 s into the parent's 182 s prefill and finished in 13.1 s, max_concurrent_prefilling reached 2, lane-probe overlap 1.16 (wall below summed), and decode_batches_by_width recorded its first b2 batches (21)
verdict.requirement: host_spare_bytes 3.13-3.35 GiB against the 2.147 GiB reserve, i.e. 1.13-1.28 GiB of headroom above the 1 GiB margin
verdict.fragile: the same server fell back to growth_allowed false with host_headroom 0.85 GiB while this session's own 108,858-token request was in flight, so the margin is thin at the 9G cap and thinner at 10G
